content.text:
## Result
Confidence: high
Verification: verified
Evidence Quality: high (8 exact, 0 partial, 0 dropped)
Search Coverage: repo-wide search; 20 file read(s), 7 grep search(es).

## Answer
NO 'developer' role exists. Authorization is two-tier: 'admin' (hardcoded ADMIN_USERS) vs 'authenticated user'. Frontend uses ProtectedRoute (auth only) or AdminProtectedRoute (ADMIN_USERS check). Backend APIs have THREE inconsistent patterns: (1) requireAdminAuth middleware checking ADMIN_USERS list (dashboard, users, conversations, user-blocks), (2) Custom verifyAdminAuth checking only database existence NOT ADMIN_USERS (feedback, announcements), (3) No admin check, only AEGIS token (user-info, notifications). This inconsistency means some 'admin' APIs are accessible to any user in admin_user_info table regardless of ADMIN_USERS membership.

## Targets
- [read] `components/auth/AdminProtectedRoute.tsx:12-71` - Frontend guard checks if userId in ADMIN_USERS list
- [read] `lib/admin-auth.ts:5-17` (E2) - ADMIN_USERS list - 17 hardcoded admin IDs
- [read] `lib/admin-auth.ts:70-95` (E4) - Shared requireAdminAuth checks ADMIN_USERS
- [read] `app/api/admin/dashboard/route.ts:4-14` (E5) - Pattern A: Uses requireAdminAuth middleware
- [read] `app/api/admin/feedback/route.ts:5-42` - Pattern B: Custom check ignores ADMIN_USERS list
- [read] `app/api/user-info/route.ts:5-42` - Pattern C: Only AEGIS token, no admin check
- [read] `components/auth/AdminProtectedRoute.tsx:34-54` (E1) - AdminProtectedRoute checks ADMIN_USERS.includes(user.userId)
- [read] `lib/admin-auth.ts:42-44` (E3) - checkAdminPermission requires ADMIN_USERS membership
- [read] `app/api/admin/feedback/route.ts:29-35` (E6) - Feedback checks database only, ignores ADMIN_USERS (Pattern B)
- [read] `app/api/user-info/route.ts:38-41` (E7) - UserInfo only checks AEGIS token (Pattern C)
- [read] `prisma/schema.prisma:70-77` (E8) - Schema has is_admin field, no developer role

## Evidence (8 items, confidence: high)
- E1 `components/auth/AdminProtectedRoute.tsx:34-54` - AdminProtectedRoute checks ADMIN_USERS.includes(user.userId)
- E2 `lib/admin-auth.ts:5-17` - ADMIN_USERS hardcoded array with 17 user IDs
- E3 `lib/admin-auth.ts:42-44` - checkAdminPermission requires ADMIN_USERS membership
- E4 `lib/admin-auth.ts:70-95` - requireAdminAuth returns 403 if not in ADMIN_USERS
- E5 `app/api/admin/dashboard/route.ts:4-14` - Dashboard uses requireAdminAuth (Pattern A)
- E6 `app/api/admin/feedback/route.ts:29-35` - Feedback checks database only, ignores ADMIN_USERS (Pattern B)
- E7 `app/api/user-info/route.ts:38-41` - UserInfo only checks AEGIS token (Pattern C)
- E8 `prisma/schema.prisma:70-77` - Schema has is_admin field, no developer role
